assignment.objective: Integrate the four Kabir child streams: reusable incremental state, scoped macro expansion, project-relative multifile dependencies, and independent equivalence/performance evidence. Resolve issues #8 and #9 without duplicating layout or silently substituting unsupported glyphs.

FT-002.adaptation: Accepted FT-002 revision 4 at input main 81f02dc under allocation openai-kabir-plus-ft002-stage4. Three of the four child streams named in the objective are already delivered on this branch: reusable incremental state (6b13034), scoped macro expansion and preamble handling (01fb13c), project-relative multifile dependencies with per-file source identity (3ae7d9b), and independent equivalence and performance evidence (benchmark plus byte-identical-to-clean-build assertions, rerun by me). Issue #8 reproductions should already pass and will be verified against its exact JSON lines. Issue #9 is the real remaining work: the compiler emits fraction bars as box-drawing text and Greek/radical as Unicode, which crates/pdf cannot encode in base-14 and silently turns into question marks. Rev 4 forbids silent glyph substitution, so this needs a shared representation or a tested adapter; crates/pdf belongs to FT-009 and will not be edited from here.

report.next_action: Execute the issue #9 plan: delete the duplicate src/pdf.rs, add the tested glyph adapter, add a lossy-export diagnostic. Then verify issue #8 reproductions and reply.

origin/main.adaptation: Resolved a span-invariant conflict the worker correctly refused to decide alone. The old assertion required every item to equal its literal source slice, which was too strong: generated numbers and substituted glyphs have no corresponding source text. Restated as three categories, all of which must point at bytes the author typed, with slicing asserted for every item without exception and exact matching still required for literal text. The invariant was made precise, not weakened.
